name: sheldon

patches.old:
download() {
    local _url=$1; shift
    local _curl_arg
    local _dld

    if [ "${1-}" = "--progress" ]; then
        shift
        _curl_arg="--progress-bar"
    else
        _curl_arg="--silent"
    fi

    if check_cmd curl; then
        _dld=curl
    elif check_cmd wget; then
        _dld=wget
    else
        _dld='curl or wget'  # to be used in error message of need_cmd
    fi

    if [ "$_url" = --check ]; then
        need_cmd "$_dld"
    elif [ "$_dld" = curl ]; then
        curl $_curl_arg --proto '=https' --show-error --fail --location "$@" "$_url"
    elif [ "$_dld" = wget ]; then
        wget --no-verbose --https-only "$@" "$_url"
    else
        err "unknown downloader"  # should not reach here
    fi
}

get_release_assets() {
    local _repo=$1
    local _tag=$2
    local _targets

    need_cmd grep
    need_cmd cut

    get_release_info "$_repo" "$_tag"
    _targets=$(echo "$RETVAL" | grep 'name' | grep -E '(\.tgz|\.tar\.gz|\tar\.xz)"' | cut -f 4 -d '"')

    RETVAL="$_targets"
}

resources.checksum_source: locally-pinned after HTTPS download; not independent upstream verification

smoke:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/sheldon"; printf 'shell = "bash"
[plugins]
' > "$HOME/.config/sheldon/plugins.toml"; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/sheldon" lock; "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/sheldon" source > /tmp/sheldon-source.sh; bash -n /tmp/sheldon-source.sh; test -f "$HOME/.local/share/sheldon/plugins.lock"
notes: Converts the official documented shell installation path with exact patches, pinned version and bundled resources.
Upstream source is fetched from a fixed Git commit at build time rather than vendored. Runtime software license remains upstream.

Pins the release asset list for the requested version/target instead of hashing mutable GitHub API metadata. Original archive scoring, extraction, overwrite protection and installation remain active; first-use builds require only immutable source/archive URLs.
